payout_quote: Referring member and referred member will each receive $50.00 for each referral that results in a new membership being opened during promotional runtime.
steps: Tell a friend about Old Hickory Credit Union and invite them to join.
Friend provides your name and address when signing up and opens a new membership.
catches: Friend must be new to OHCU (no accounts in the last 120 days); your name and address must be given at the time of account opening — retroactive credit not possible.
Bonuses are subject to IRS reporting requirements; recipients responsible for income tax reporting.
Promotion may be extended, altered, modified, or canceled at any time; no cap stated on the page.
See credit union for complete details — finer payout timing not stated on the page.
biggest_catch: Your friend must name you at signup and be genuinely new (no OHCU account in 120 days); the promo can be canceled at any time and full payout timing details are 'see credit union.'
eligibility: Existing OHCU member; referred person must be new to OHCU (no accounts in last 120 days).
timing: Referral itself takes minutes; bonus timing not specified on page (ask the credit union).
